heading: Import OpenQASM
hint: Both OpenQASM 2 and OpenQASM 3 are read, and which one you have is worked out from the file. Importing replaces the circuit on screen and clears its undo history.

text.label: Or paste a program

failure.empty: There is nothing to read yet. Choose a file or paste a program above.
failure.too-large: That file is too big to read here. The importer accepts programs of up to one megabyte.
failure.unreadable: That file could not be read. Try choosing it again.
failure.syntax: Line {{line}}, column {{column}} is not something OpenQASM allows, so the rest of the file could not be read.
failure.semantic: Line {{line}}, column {{column}} is written correctly but does not mean anything: a register, a gate or an index there does not exist, or is used with the wrong number of qubits.
failure.unsupported: Line {{line}}, column {{column}} uses "{{construct}}", which is real OpenQASM that a circuit here has no shape for. Remove it or write that part another way.
failure.unsupportedUnnamed: Line {{line}}, column {{column}} uses a feature of OpenQASM that a circuit here has no shape for.
failure.limit: This file asks for more than a circuit here can hold — too many qubits, too many gates, or a structure nested too deeply. It stops at line {{line}}, column {{column}}.
failure.contract: This file was read, but the circuit it describes is not one this editor can open. Please report it: the file is valid and the fault is ours.
